CITY OF NEW YORK
DEPARTMENT OF CITYWIDE ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES (DCAS)
REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP)

SOLICITATION TITLE: Automated Vehicle Location (AVL) & Fleet Telematics Software Platform
PIN: 85626P0001
ISSUED BY: City of New York DCAS Fleet Services
PROPOSAL DUE DATE: November 15, 2026

1. SCOPE OF SERVICES
The Department of Citywide Administrative Services ("DCAS") is seeking an appropriately qualified vendor to provide enterprise telematics, real-time diagnostic trouble code (DTC) ingestion, automated fuel drift tracking, and exception reporting across 40,000 municipal vehicles operated by 75+ City agencies.

2. MINIMUM PROPOSER QUALIFICATIONS
Proposers must demonstrate a minimum of 5 years of prior experience deploying real-time telematics or enterprise IoT platforms. Failure to satisfy this threshold shall result in non-responsive disqualification.

3. SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS & COMPLIANCE CLAUSES
3.1 M/WBE Subcontracting Participation Goal:
Pursuant to NYC Administrative Code § 6-129 and Local Law 1 of 2013, this solicitation establishes an M/WBE subcontracting goal of 30%. Non-M/WBE proposers must submit an approved Schedule B utilization plan demonstrating certified subcontractor partnerships.

3.2 Prevailing Wage Mandate:
Hardware field installations and maintenance services performed under this contract are strictly subject to prevailing wage schedules governed by NY Labor Law Section 220 and mandatory weekly certified payroll submissions.

3.3 Insurance Requirements:
The Contractor must maintain:
- Commercial General Liability of $5,000,000 per occurrence.
- Network Security and Cyber Liability Insurance of $2,000,000 per claim.

3.4 Liquidated Damages:
In the event Contractor fails to deploy telematics units within the approved milestone schedule, liquidated damages of $1,500 per day shall apply.

3.5 Mandatory PASSPort Enrollment:
All proposers must have an active, verified account in the City of New York Procurement and Sourcing Solutions Portal (PASSPort) prior to proposal submission.

4. PROPOSAL EVALUATION CRITERIA
Proposals shall be evaluated according to the following criteria:
- Technical Architecture & Real-Time Ingestion: 40%
- Organizational Capability & Past Performance: 30%
- Cost & Fee Schedule: 30%
